pageDescriptionWindows: DNS and ARP caches, saved Wi-Fi profiles and the network history. The caches rebuild themselves; a removed Wi-Fi profile loses its saved password and removed history cannot be recovered.
pageDescriptionOther: DNS and ARP caches and saved Wi-Fi profiles. The caches rebuild themselves; a removed Wi-Fi profile loses its saved password.
categoryDnsCacheDesc: Domain names already resolved, kept by the system
categoryWifiProfilesDesc: Saved wireless networks, with their passwords
categoryArpCacheDesc: Mappings between IP addresses and hardware addresses
categoryNetworkHistoryDesc: Networks this PC connected to in the past
emptyNoClean: History has no network cleanup yet.
confirmCaches: The DNS and ARP caches rebuild themselves.
confirmWifiWarning: Removed Wi-Fi profiles lose their saved password: you will need to enter it again to reconnect.
confirmNetworkHistoryWarning: Network history entries are removed permanently.
